info.name: Consult API
info.description: Backend API for Consult, for local testing. Set devEmail in the environment to the local user to act as; the pre-request script signs in and refreshes the access token for you. See docs/postman/README.md.

exec: for (const ch of text) bits += B64.indexOf(ch).toString(2).padStart(6, "0");
for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) out += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(bits.slice(i, i + 8), 2));
// Sign-in also starts a Django session, and later sign-ins without a Bearer
// token are then CSRF-checked, so keep the rotated csrftoken to echo back.
// Local sign-in: the backend accepts an unsigned dev JWT whose payload carries
// the user's email (see frontend/src/global/localUsers.ts), so build one from
// devEmail and exchange it for an access token when ours is missing or expiring.
throw new Error("baseUrl or devEmail is not set: select the Consult local environment first.");
// No stored expiry counts as expired, so the first request signs in.
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ internal_access_token: storeDevToken() }) },
